24/// Entity ID prefixes that we subscribe to and convert into an [`EntityId`].
25///
26/// This is the set of prefixes we ask the Agent's tagger for, so an entity whose prefix isn't listed here never
27/// reaches us at all. Adding a prefix here requires a matching arm in [`remote_entity_id_to_entity_id`].
28const HANDLED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES: &[&str] = &[
29    "container_id",
30    "container_image_metadata",
31    "ecs_task",
32    "deployment",
33    "kubernetes_metadata",
34    "kubernetes_node",
35    "kubernetes_pod_uid",
36    "process",
37    "internal",
38];
39
40/// Entity ID prefixes that the Agent's tagger publishes but that we have reviewed and deliberately don't consume.
41///
42/// We don't subscribe to these, so they cost us nothing at runtime. Recording them here is what lets us tell a prefix
43/// we've decided against apart from one the Agent has newly added, which is the difference the
44/// `agent_entity_id_prefixes_are_all_classified` test checks for.
45///
46/// - `gpu`: keyed by GPU device UUID, which never arrives as origin information.
47/// - `kueue_workload`, `kubernetes_kueue_queue`, `kueue_resource_flavor`: the Agent folds these same Kueue tags into
48///   the pod and container entities, which we do handle, so consuming them here would be redundant.
49/// - `crd`, `kubernetes_capabilities`: describe cluster-level objects rather than workloads, and carry no identifier
50///   that origin detection can resolve.
51/// - `host`, `kubelet`: no tagger entity is ever published for these today, so they're listed only for completeness
52///   against the Agent's set of prefixes.
53const IGNORED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES: &[&str] = &[
54    "gpu",
55    "kueue_workload",
56    "kubernetes_kueue_queue",
57    "kueue_resource_flavor",
58    "crd",
59    "kubernetes_capabilities",
60    "host",
61    "kubelet",
62];

64#[static_metrics(prefix = remote_tagger_metadata_collector)]
65#[derive(Clone)]
66struct Telemetry {
67    rpc_errors_total: Counter,
68    intern_failed_total: Counter,
69    events_added_total: Counter,
70    events_modified_total: Counter,
71    events_deleted_total: Counter,
72}
73
74/// A workload provider that uses the remote tagger API from a Datadog Agent to provide workload information.
75pub struct RemoteAgentTaggerMetadataCollector {
76    client: RemoteAgentClient,
77    interner: GenericMapInterner,
78    health: Health,
79    telemetry: Telemetry,
80}
81
82impl RemoteAgentTaggerMetadataCollector {
83    /// Creates a new `RemoteAgentTaggerMetadataCollector` from the given configuration.
84    ///
85    /// ## Errors
86    ///
87    /// If the Agent gRPC client can't be created (invalid API endpoint, missing authentication token, etc), or if the
88    /// authentication token is invalid, an error will be returned.
89    pub async fn new(
90        client_config: &RemoteAgentClientConfiguration, health: Health, interner: GenericMapInterner,
91    ) -> Result<Self, GenericError> {
92        let client = RemoteAgentClient::connect(client_config).await?;
93
94        Ok(Self {
95            client,
96            interner,
97            health,
98            telemetry: Telemetry::new(),
99        })
100    }
101
102    fn try_intern(&self, value: &str) -> Option<MetaString> {
103        match self.interner.try_intern(value) {
104            Some(interned) => Some(MetaString::from(interned)),
105            None => {
106                self.telemetry.intern_failed_total().increment(1);
107                None
108            }
109        }
110    }
111
112    fn owned_tags_into_tagset(&self, tags: Vec<String>) -> Option<TagSet> {
113        // We'll either inline the tags if they're short enough, otherwise we intern them.
114        let mut new_tags = Vec::with_capacity(tags.len());
115        for tag in tags {
116            let new_tag = match MetaString::try_inline(&tag) {
117                Some(s) => Tag::from(s),
118                None => {
119                    let interned = self.try_intern(&tag)?;
120                    Tag::from(interned)
121                }
122            };
123
124            new_tags.push(new_tag);
125        }
126
127        Some(TagSet::from_iter(new_tags))
128    }
129
130    fn track_event(&self, event_type: EventType) {
131        match event_type {
132            EventType::Added => {
133                self.telemetry.events_added_total().increment(1);
134            }
135            EventType::Modified => {
136                self.telemetry.events_modified_total().increment(1);
137            }
138            EventType::Deleted => {
139                self.telemetry.events_deleted_total().increment(1);
140            }
141        }
142    }
143}

145#[async_trait]
146impl MetadataCollector for RemoteAgentTaggerMetadataCollector {
147    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
148        "remote_agent_tags"
149    }
150
151    async fn watch(&mut self, operations_tx: &mut mpsc::Sender<MetadataOperation>) -> Result<(), GenericError> {
152        self.health.mark_ready();
153
154        let prefixes = HANDLED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES
155            .iter()
156            .map(|prefix| prefix.to_string())
157            .collect();
158        let mut entity_stream = self
159            .client
160            .get_tagger_stream(RemoteTagCardinality::High, Some(prefixes))
161            .map_err(StatusError::from);
162        debug!("Established tagger entity stream.");
163
164        loop {
165            select! {
166                _ = self.health.live() => {},
167                maybe_response = entity_stream.next() => match maybe_response {
168                    Some(Ok(response)) => {
169                        trace!("Received tagger stream event.");
170
171                        for event in response.events {
172                            let event_type = match EventType::try_from(event.r#type) {
173                                Ok(event_type) => event_type,
174                                Err(_) => {
175                                    debug!("Received tagger stream event with unknown type: {}", event.r#type);
176                                    continue;
177                                }
178                            };
179
180                            let entity = match event.entity {
181                                Some(entity) => entity,
182                                None => {
183                                    debug!("Received tagger stream event with no entity.");
184                                    continue;
185                                }
186                            };
187
188                            let entity_id = match entity.id.and_then(remote_entity_id_to_entity_id) {
189                                Some(entity_id) => entity_id,
190                                None => {
191                                    debug!("Received tagger stream event with missing or invalid entity ID.");
192                                    continue;
193                                }
194                            };
195
196                            self.track_event(event_type);
197
198                            let maybe_operation = match event_type {
199                                EventType::Added | EventType::Modified => {
200                                    let entity_tags = [
201                                        (OriginTagCardinality::Low, entity.low_cardinality_tags),
202                                        (OriginTagCardinality::Orchestrator, entity.orchestrator_cardinality_tags),
203                                        (OriginTagCardinality::High, entity.high_cardinality_tags),
204                                    ];
205
206                                    let mut actions = Vec::new();
207                                    for (cardinality, tags) in entity_tags {
208                                        if !tags.is_empty() {
209                                            match self.owned_tags_into_tagset(tags) {
210                                                Some(tags) => actions.push(MetadataAction::SetTags { cardinality, tags }),
211                                                None => {
212                                                    warn!(%entity_id, %cardinality, "Failed to intern tags for entity. Tags will not be present.");
213                                                }
214                                            }
215                                        }
216                                    }
217
218                                    if actions.is_empty() {
219                                        None
220                                    } else {
221                                        Some(MetadataOperation {
222                                            entity_id,
223                                            actions: actions.into(),
224                                        })
225                                    }
226                                }
227                                EventType::Deleted => Some(MetadataOperation::delete(entity_id)),
228                            };
229
230                            if let Some(operation) = maybe_operation {
231                                if let Err(e) = operations_tx.send(operation).await {
232                                    debug!(error = %e, "Failed to send metadata operation.");
233                                }
234                            }
235                        }
236
237                        trace!("Processed tagger stream event.");
238                    },
239                    Some(Err(e)) => {
240                        self.telemetry.rpc_errors_total().increment(1);
241                        return Err(e.into())
242                    },
243                    None => break,
244                }
245            }
246        }
247
248        self.health.mark_not_ready();
249
250        Ok(())
251    }
252}

254impl MemoryBounds for RemoteAgentTaggerMetadataCollector {
255    fn specify_bounds(&self, builder: &mut MemoryBoundsBuilder) {
256        // TODO: Kind of a throwaway calculation because nothing about the gRPC client can really be bounded at the
257        // moment.
258        builder
259            .firm()
260            .with_fixed_amount("self struct", std::mem::size_of::<Self>());
261    }
262}
263
264fn remote_entity_id_to_entity_id(remote_entity_id: RemoteEntityId) -> Option<EntityId> {
265    // TODO: In the future, it would be nice to do zero-copy deserialization so that we could just intern them (or
266    // inline them) directly instead of having to deal with the owned strings... but for now, we can transparently
267    // convert the owned `String`s to `MetaString`s so it's not a huge deal.
268    match remote_entity_id.prefix.as_str() {
269        "container_id" => Some(EntityId::Container(remote_entity_id.uid.into())),
270        "container_image_metadata" => Some(EntityId::ContainerImageMetadata(remote_entity_id.uid.into())),
271        "ecs_task" => Some(EntityId::EcsTask(remote_entity_id.uid.into())),
272        "deployment" => Some(EntityId::KubernetesDeployment(remote_entity_id.uid.into())),
273        "kubernetes_metadata" => Some(EntityId::KubernetesMetadata(remote_entity_id.uid.into())),
274        "kubernetes_node" => Some(EntityId::KubernetesNode(remote_entity_id.uid.into())),
275        "kubernetes_pod_uid" => Some(EntityId::PodUid(remote_entity_id.uid.into())),
276        "process" => Some(EntityId::Process(remote_entity_id.uid.into())),
277        "internal" => match remote_entity_id.uid.as_str() {
278            "global-entity-id" => Some(EntityId::Global),
279            uid => {
280                warn!("Unhandled internal entity ID: internal://{}", uid);
281                None
282            }
283        },
284        // Entities we've reviewed and don't consume. See `IGNORED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES` for why each one is here.
285        //
286        // We don't subscribe to these, so in practice they never arrive at all.
287        prefix if IGNORED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES.contains(&prefix) => None,
288        // Anything we didn't ask for. The Agent filters the stream by the prefixes we subscribe to, so reaching this
289        // arm means either the Agent ignored our filter or it's too old to support one.
290        prefix => {
291            warn!("Unhandled entity ID prefix: {}://{}", prefix, remote_entity_id.uid);
292            None
293        }
294    }
295}

297#[cfg(test)]
298mod tests {
299    use super::*;
300
301    #[test]
302    fn converts_all_otlp_metric_entity_prefixes_from_the_remote_tagger() {
303        let cases = [
304            ("container_id", "container", EntityId::Container("container".into())),
305            (
306                "container_image_metadata",
307                "sha256:image",
308                EntityId::ContainerImageMetadata("sha256:image".into()),
309            ),
310            ("ecs_task", "task", EntityId::EcsTask("task".into())),
311            (
312                "deployment",
313                "default/api",
314                EntityId::KubernetesDeployment("default/api".into()),
315            ),
316            (
317                "kubernetes_metadata",
318                "/namespaces//default",
319                EntityId::KubernetesMetadata("/namespaces//default".into()),
320            ),
321            ("kubernetes_node", "node", EntityId::KubernetesNode("node".into())),
322            ("kubernetes_pod_uid", "pod", EntityId::PodUid("pod".into())),
323            ("process", "42", EntityId::Process("42".into())),
324        ];
325
326        for (prefix, uid, expected) in cases {
327            assert_eq!(
328                remote_entity_id_to_entity_id(RemoteEntityId {
329                    prefix: prefix.to_owned(),
330                    uid: uid.to_owned(),
331                }),
332                Some(expected),
333                "{prefix}://{uid}"
334            );
335        }
336    }
337
338    /// The Agent's set of tagger entity ID prefixes, regenerated nightly by
339    /// `.github/workflows/update-agent-tagger-prefixes.yml`.
340    const AGENT_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES: &str = include_str!(concat!(
341        env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
342        "/tests/fixtures/agent_tagger_entity_id_prefixes.txt"
343    ));
344
345    fn agent_entity_id_prefixes() -> Vec<&'static str> {
346        AGENT_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES
347            .lines()
348            .map(|line| line.trim())
349            .filter(|line| !line.is_empty() && !line.starts_with('#'))
350            .collect()
351    }
352
353    #[test]
354    fn agent_entity_id_prefix_fixture_is_intact() {
355        // A truncated or empty fixture would make `agent_entity_id_prefixes_are_all_classified` pass without checking
356        // anything, so assert that it still looks like the Agent's list before we rely on it. The generating workflow
357        // performs the same check, but the fixture can also be edited by hand.
358        let prefixes = agent_entity_id_prefixes();
359
360        assert!(
361            prefixes.len() >= HANDLED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES.len(),
362            "fixture lists only {} prefixes, which is fewer than the {} we handle: it is likely truncated",
363            prefixes.len(),
364            HANDLED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES.len(),
365        );
366
367        for anchor in ["container_id", "kubernetes_pod_uid", "internal"] {
368            assert!(
369                prefixes.contains(&anchor),
370                "fixture is missing the long-standing `{anchor}` prefix, so it is likely truncated or malformed"
371            );
372        }
373    }
374
375    #[test]
376    fn agent_entity_id_prefixes_are_all_classified() {
377        // Note that we deliberately don't assert the other direction. Remote agents run alongside a range of Agent
378        // versions, so a prefix that the Agent has since removed may still need handling for older Agents.
379        for prefix in agent_entity_id_prefixes() {
380            assert!(
381                HANDLED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES.contains(&prefix) || IGNORED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES.contains(&prefix),
382                "the Agent's tagger publishes `{prefix}://` entities but the runtime neither handles nor ignores them. \
383                 Either add `{prefix}` to `HANDLED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES` along with an arm in \
384                 `remote_entity_id_to_entity_id` that converts it, or add it to `IGNORED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES` with a \
385                 comment explaining why we don't need it."
386            );
387        }
388    }
389
390    #[test]
391    fn prefix_lists_agree_with_conversion() {
392        // The prefixes we subscribe to determine what the Agent sends us, so a prefix listed as handled but missing an
393        // arm here (or vice versa) would silently drop entities we asked for.
394        //
395        // `internal` only converts for a single UID, so use that UID throughout: every other prefix treats it as an
396        // opaque value.
397        for prefix in HANDLED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES {
398            assert!(
399                remote_entity_id_to_entity_id(RemoteEntityId {
400                    prefix: (*prefix).to_owned(),
401                    uid: "global-entity-id".to_owned(),
402                })
403                .is_some(),
404                "`{prefix}` is subscribed to but isn't converted by `remote_entity_id_to_entity_id`"
405            );
406
407            assert!(
408                !IGNORED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES.contains(prefix),
409                "`{prefix}` is listed as both handled and ignored"
410            );
411        }
412
413        for prefix in IGNORED_ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES {
414            assert_eq!(
415                remote_entity_id_to_entity_id(RemoteEntityId {
416                    prefix: (*prefix).to_owned(),
417                    uid: "global-entity-id".to_owned(),
418                }),
419                None,
420                "`{prefix}` is listed as ignored but is converted by `remote_entity_id_to_entity_id`"
421            );
422        }
423    }
